products.name: Storefront
products.state: Bounded local Connected order, issuance and receipt retention implemented
products.evidence: The first-class Storefront and Backstage adapter preserve the governed product identity and order contract. The accepted GHE-06 restricted profile covers the locked Python, Node, npm, Playwright, Firefox, and Backstage-transport graph; full create-app/Yarn backend generation, remote customer catalog collection, customer-runner operation, and live GHES remain outside that bounded acceptance. Merged local Connected retention preserves synthetic orders, exact issuance and verified Forge receipts across restart. Retained-state validation rejects incompatible or inconsistent records before handoff; local crash/retry/restore evidence does not establish customer tenancy or hosted activation.
products.nextMilestone: Complete independently gated customer identity/session isolation and operational-readiness controls. Hosted durable-storage activation, GHE-07 customer-runner/live GHES and GHE-08 support acceptance remain separate gates.
